verdict.rationale: Figure and chart extraction is a fair question for a document-parsing product like Datalab, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions figure or chart handling: no image crops, no VLM-generated descriptions, and no per-figure page positions. The only traceability evidence is bounding-box citations for schema-based field extraction (datalab-docs-18), and generic Markdown/HTML/JSON conversion (datalab-docs-31) does not show that figures come with source positions. Neither supports this story.
